//: Research a topic, refine the notes until the critic approves (at most 3 rounds), then write two outputs in parallel.
name: research_pipeline
description: Sequential research -> review loop -> parallel publish.

nodes.name: research
nodes.system_prompt: You are a careful researcher. Reply with concise bullet-point notes.

nodes.name: critic
nodes.system_prompt: Review the notes. Reply with exactly APPROVED if they are complete and correct, otherwise list what is missing.

nodes.name: to_markdown
nodes.system_prompt: Turn the notes into a well-structured Markdown article.

nodes.name: to_summary
nodes.system_prompt: Summarise the notes in two sentences.
